# BYZ scope. Calm enough for this line's events (design 4.1): no civil war, no theme revolt, not the house of Osman's chain,
# the City not lost. World steps do not read it.
oe_alb_calm = {
    in_civil_war = no
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw_active }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw2_active }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_active }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_osman_chain_active }
    oe_l7_fallen = no
}
# Country scope. A country a world step may act on: AI, outside the empire's bloc, neither the Ottomans nor Venice.
oe_alb_free = { is_ai = yes NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } NOT = { tag = TUR } NOT = { tag = VEN } }
# Country scope. Such a country holds land in the Albanian area (W1 counts them: at least two).
oe_alb_area_owner = { oe_alb_free = yes any_owned_location = { area = area:albania_area } }
# Country scope. An Albanian lord (W1, W5, .1): holds land in the area and is seated there or Albanian; Zeta, AI and outside
# the bloc, counts too.
oe_alb_lord = {
    OR = {
        AND = { oe_alb_area_owner = yes OR = { capital ?= { area = area:albania_area } culture = culture:albanian } }
        AND = { tag = ZTA is_ai = yes NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } }
    }
}
# Location scope. Its owner may hand it over in peace: a free owner (above) that controls it, no siege, and not its capital
# unless it is the owner's last place (Latin Greece's ep13 rule).
oe_alb_loc_free = { has_owner = yes owner = { oe_alb_free = yes } controller ?= owner has_siege = no OR = { is_capital = no owner = { NOT = { any_owned_location = { count >= 2 } } } } }
# Location scope. A player or the empire's bloc owns it (a world step that would take it is skipped for this place).
oe_alb_loc_out = { has_owner = yes owner = { OR = { is_ai = no oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } }
# Any scope. The Ottomans exist, are AI, outside the bloc, and the house of Osman's chain is not running.
oe_alb_tur_ok = {
    country_exists = c:TUR
    NOT = { c:BYZ = { has_variable = oe_osman_chain_active } }
    c:TUR = { is_ai = yes NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } }
}
oe_alb_tur_out = {
    OR = {
        c:BYZ = { has_variable = oe_osman_chain_active }
        AND = { country_exists = c:TUR c:TUR = { OR = { is_ai = no oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } }
    }
}
# Any scope. Venice exists, is AI and outside the bloc / is a player's or on the empire's side.
oe_alb_ven_ok = { country_exists = c:VEN c:VEN = { is_ai = yes NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } }
oe_alb_ven_out = { country_exists = c:VEN c:VEN = { OR = { is_ai = no oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } }
# Any scope. The bloc holds land in the Albanian area or in northern Greece (.2, design 4.4: the simpler of the two forms).
oe_alb_bloc_near = {
    OR = {
        area:albania_area = { any_location_in_area = { has_owner = yes owner = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } }
        area:northern_greece_area = { any_location_in_area = { has_owner = yes owner = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Can pay $months$ months of income (oe_fin_month, the finance line's unit).
oe_alb_can_pay = { gold >= { value = oe_fin_month multiply = $months$ } }

# ---- Skanderbeg and his realm (phases 2-3, design 4.3)
# Any scope. Skanderbeg's recorded country still exists on the map.
oe_alb_sk_alive = { has_global_variable = oe_alb_sk_c country_exists = global_var:oe_alb_sk_c }
# Any scope. Skanderbeg's country is AI, outside the bloc, neither TUR nor VEN.
oe_alb_sk_ai = { oe_alb_sk_alive = yes global_var:oe_alb_sk_c = { oe_alb_free = yes } }
# Any scope. Vanilla's Skanderbeg already rules some country (W6 case 1).
oe_alb_van_sk_ruler = { exists = character:skanderbeg_kastrioti character:skanderbeg_kastrioti = { is_alive = yes is_ruler = yes } }
# Any scope. Skanderbeg (vanilla's or ours) is alive and ruling oe_alb_sk_c.
oe_alb_sk_rules = {
    oe_alb_sk_alive = yes
    OR = {
        AND = { exists = character:skanderbeg_kastrioti character:skanderbeg_kastrioti = { is_alive = yes is_ruler_of = global_var:oe_alb_sk_c } }
        AND = { exists = character:oe_alb_skanderbeg character:oe_alb_skanderbeg = { is_alive = yes is_ruler_of = global_var:oe_alb_sk_c } }
    }
}
# Any scope. Krujë is held in hand by an AI owner outside the bloc (TUR allowed; W6 case 2/3).

# Country scope. Eligible member of the League of Lezhë (W7): Skanderbeg's realm, AI Albanian area owners, and AI Zeta.
oe_alb_league_member = {
    OR = {
        AND = { oe_alb_sk_ai = yes this = global_var:oe_alb_sk_c }
        oe_alb_area_owner = yes
        AND = { tag = ZTA is_ai = yes NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } }
    }
}
# Any scope. Krujë is held in hand by an AI non-bloc non-TUR owner (W12, .8).
oe_alb_kruje_non_tur = {
    location:kruje = {
        has_owner = yes

        controller ?= owner
        has_siege = no
    }
}

# BYZ scope. The chronicle (gen_chronicle.py row alb). Void: closed and nothing of it happened. Ended: closed.
oe_alb_any = { OR = { global_var:oe_alb_ws_1 ?= 1 global_var:oe_alb_ws_1 ?= 5 global_var:oe_alb_ws_2 ?= 1 global_var:oe_alb_ws_2 ?= 5 global_var:oe_alb_ws_3 ?= 1 global_var:oe_alb_ws_3 ?= 5 global_var:oe_alb_ws_4 ?= 1 global_var:oe_alb_ws_4 ?= 5 global_var:oe_alb_ws_5 ?= 1 global_var:oe_alb_ws_5 ?= 5 global_var:oe_alb_ws_6 ?= 1 global_var:oe_alb_ws_6 ?= 5 global_var:oe_alb_ws_7 ?= 1 global_var:oe_alb_ws_7 ?= 5 global_var:oe_alb_ws_8 ?= 1 global_var:oe_alb_ws_8 ?= 5 global_var:oe_alb_ws_9 ?= 1 global_var:oe_alb_ws_9 ?= 5 global_var:oe_alb_ws_10 ?= 1 global_var:oe_alb_ws_10 ?= 5 global_var:oe_alb_ws_11 ?= 1 global_var:oe_alb_ws_11 ?= 5 global_var:oe_alb_ws_12 ?= 1 global_var:oe_alb_ws_12 ?= 5 has_global_variable = oe_alb_durres has_global_variable = oe_alb_sk } }
oe_alb_chr_void = { has_variable = oe_alb_off oe_alb_any = no }
oe_alb_chr_done = { has_variable = oe_alb_off }
oe_alb_chr_run = { oe_alb_any = yes }
